chapterInfo.content:
25
1Sɛ ɔham ba nnipa mmienu ntam a, wɔmmra asɛnniiɛ, na wɔmmu wɔn atɛn, na wɔmmu ɔteneneeni bem, na wɔmmu ɔbɔnefoɔ fɔ. 2Na sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ no di hweɛ a, ɔtemmufoɔ no mma no nna fam, na wɔnhwe no wɔ n’anim, dodoɔ a ɛsɛ ne bɔne no. 3#2 Ko 11.24 Mmaa aduanan na wɔnka no, ɛntra so, na wantra so anhwe no mmaa pii ansene yei, na wo nua annane w’ani so ɔhohorani.
4 # 1 Ko 9.9; 1 Ti 5.18 Nkata nantwie a ɔpore ayuo ano.
5 # Rut 4.5; Mat 22.24 Sɛ anuanom tena faako na wɔn mu baako wu na ɔnni ba a, owufoɔ no yere nnkɔ baabi nnkɔware ɔhɔhoɔ; ne kunu nua nkɔ ne ho nware no, na ɔnyɛ ekunu nua ayɛdeɛ mma no. 6Na abakan a ɔbaa no bɛwo no no, wɔmfa ne nua a ɔwuiɛ no din nto no, na ne din ampepa amfiri Israel. 7Na sɛ ɔbarima no mpɛ sɛ ɔware ne nua yere no a, ɛnneɛ ne nua yere no nkɔ kuro pono ano mpanimfoɔ nkyɛn nkɔka sɛ: Me kunu nua mpɛ sɛ ɔma ne nua din tena Israel, ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ me ekunu nua ayɛdeɛ. 8Na ne kurom mpanimfoɔ no mfrɛ no nkasa nkyerɛ no, na sɛ ɔgyina hɔ ka sɛ: Mempɛ sɛ meware no a, 9ɛnneɛ ne nua yere no ntwe mpini no mpanimfoɔ no anim, na ɔnyi ɔbarima no nan ase mpaboa, na ɔnhinam n’ani so ntasuo nka sɛ: Saa na wɔnyɛ ɔbarima a ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔsiesie ne nua fie. 10Na wɔmfrɛ ne fie wɔ Israel mu sɛ: Deɛ wɔayi ne nan ase mpaboa no fie.
11Sɛ mmarima reko, obi ne ne nua, na ɔbaako yere twe pini sɛ ɔrebɛgye ne kunu afiri deɛ ɔrehwe no no nsam, na ɔbaa no tene ne nsa sɔ ne barima mu a, 12ɛnneɛ twa ɔbaa no nsa; mma w’ani nnhu no mmɔbɔ.
13 # Lew 19.35-36 Nnya abrammoɔ ahodoɔ mmienu, kɛseɛ ne ketewa, wɔ wo fotoɔ mu. 14Nnya efa ahodoɔ mmienu, kɛseɛ ne ketewa, wɔ wo fie. 15Nya abrammokwanmu a ɛtene, nya efa a ɛduro na ɛtene, na wo nna aware asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so. 16#Mika 6.11 Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ ne wɔn a wɔyɛ yeinom nyinaa, wɔn a wɔtwa nkontompo nyinaa.
Wɔmpepa Amalek nkaeɛ
17 # Eks 17.8-16 Kae deɛ Amalek yɛɛ wo kwan soɔ berɛ a mofiri Misraim reba no, 18sɛdeɛ ɔbɛtoaa wo ɛkwan soɔ, berɛ a woatɔ piti na woabrɛ, na ɔtwaa wɔn a aka w’akyire no nyinaa guiɛ wɔ w’akyire, na wansuro Onyankopɔn. 19#1 Sa 15.2-3 Enti sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ma wo ɔhome firi w’atamfo a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia nyinaa nsa, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa tena soɔ no so a, pepa Amalek nkaeɛ firi asase so; mma wo werɛ mmfi.

pageProps.chapterText:
Sɛ ɔham ba nnipa mmienu ntam a, wɔmmra asɛnniiɛ, na wɔmmu wɔn atɛn, na wɔmmu ɔteneneeni bem, na wɔmmu ɔbɔnefoɔ fɔ. Na sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ no di hweɛ a, ɔtemmufoɔ no mma no nna fam, na wɔnhwe no wɔ n’anim, dodoɔ a ɛsɛ ne bɔne no. Mmaa aduanan na wɔnka no, ɛntra so, na wantra so anhwe no mmaa pii ansene yei, na wo nua annane w’ani so ɔhohorani.
Nkata nantwie a ɔpore ayuo ano.
Sɛ anuanom tena faako na wɔn mu baako wu na ɔnni ba a, owufoɔ no yere nnkɔ baabi nnkɔware ɔhɔhoɔ; ne kunu nua nkɔ ne ho nware no, na ɔnyɛ ekunu nua ayɛdeɛ mma no. Na abakan a ɔbaa no bɛwo no no, wɔmfa ne nua a ɔwuiɛ no din nto no, na ne din ampepa amfiri Israel. Na sɛ ɔbarima no mpɛ sɛ ɔware ne nua yere no a, ɛnneɛ ne nua yere no nkɔ kuro pono ano mpanimfoɔ nkyɛn nkɔka sɛ: Me kunu nua mpɛ sɛ ɔma ne nua din tena Israel, ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ me ekunu nua ayɛdeɛ. Na ne kurom mpanimfoɔ no mfrɛ no nkasa nkyerɛ no, na sɛ ɔgyina hɔ ka sɛ: Mempɛ sɛ meware no a, ɛnneɛ ne nua yere no ntwe mpini no mpanimfoɔ no anim, na ɔnyi ɔbarima no nan ase mpaboa, na ɔnhinam n’ani so ntasuo nka sɛ: Saa na wɔnyɛ ɔbarima a ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔsiesie ne nua fie. Na wɔmfrɛ ne fie wɔ Israel mu sɛ: Deɛ wɔayi ne nan ase mpaboa no fie.
Sɛ mmarima reko, obi ne ne nua, na ɔbaako yere twe pini sɛ ɔrebɛgye ne kunu afiri deɛ ɔrehwe no no nsam, na ɔbaa no tene ne nsa sɔ ne barima mu a, ɛnneɛ twa ɔbaa no nsa; mma w’ani nnhu no mmɔbɔ.
Nnya abrammoɔ ahodoɔ mmienu, kɛseɛ ne ketewa, wɔ wo fotoɔ mu. Nnya efa ahodoɔ mmienu, kɛseɛ ne ketewa, wɔ wo fie. Nya abrammokwanmu a ɛtene, nya efa a ɛduro na ɛtene, na wo nna aware asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so. Na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn akyiwadeɛ ne wɔn a wɔyɛ yeinom nyinaa, wɔn a wɔtwa nkontompo nyinaa.

Kae deɛ Amalek yɛɛ wo kwan soɔ berɛ a mofiri Misraim reba no, sɛdeɛ ɔbɛtoaa wo ɛkwan soɔ, berɛ a woatɔ piti na woabrɛ, na ɔtwaa wɔn a aka w’akyire no nyinaa guiɛ wɔ w’akyire, na wansuro Onyankopɔn. Enti sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ma wo ɔhome firi w’atamfo a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia nyinaa nsa, asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema wo sɛ fa tena soɔ no so a, pepa Amalek nkaeɛ firi asase so; mma wo werɛ mmfi.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
